<!-- stormworks-research-gap:family:ducted-fan -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts/ducted-fan).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> fan_small: definition attribute force_emitter_max_force. Force-emitter configuration; not measured thrust.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/7/findings/0/detail`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> fan_large: definition attribute force_emitter_max_force. Force-emitter configuration; not measured thrust.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/7/findings/1/detail`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Ducted Fan: decode remaining behavior and formulas
